english.title: Attend place for instruction / training for terrorism
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attended at a place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), while instruction or training of the type mentioned in section 6(1) of the Terrorism Act 2006 or section 54(1) of the Terrorism Act 2000 was provided there wholly or partly for purposes connected with the commission or preparation of acts of terrorism or Convention offences and you knew or believed, or a person attending at that place throughout the period of your attendance could not reasonably have failed to understand, that instruction or training was being provided there wholly or partly for purposes connected with the commission or preparation of acts of terrorism or Convention offences
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8 of the Terrorism Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 8(3) of the Terrorism Act 2006 provides that it is immaterial whether the offender receives instruction/training himself; and whether the instruction/training is provided for purposes connected with one or more particular acts of terrorism/Convention offences, acts of terrorism/Convention offences of a particular description or acts of terrorism/Convention offences generally.
(ii) Section 8(6) of the Act provides that references to instruction or training being provided include references to it being made available.
(iii) Also consider the offences of training for terrorism (H8457 and H8458) and offences regarding weapons training (H3785, H3786 and H3787).
(iv) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17 of the Act.
(v) For the liability of company directors etc. see section 18 of the Act.
(vi) Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, section 19 of the Act.
(vii) See also Home Office Circular 8/2006 , including explanations about this section.
(viii) Attendance at a place used for terrorist training can be within the UK or elsewhere, section 8(1)(a).
(ix) For offence before 29th June 2021, see H8459/TR06010.

other.powersofarrest:
For terrorist offences primarily consider: Arrest without warrant - terrorism
Also applicable: Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
Summary: imprisonment for a term not exceeding twelve months and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: imprisonment for a term not exceeding fourteen years and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNotes
(i) In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
(ii) On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
